question: Explain whether merchandise sales changed mainly because of order volume or average merchandise per order. If sales declined, drill down by category and seller.

evidence.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-05-01') THEN o.order_id END) AS baseline_orders, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-05-01') THEN COALESCE(i.price,0) ELSE 0 END),2) AS baseline_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-02-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-03-01') THEN o.order_id END) AS target_orders, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-02-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-03-01') THEN COALESCE(i.price,0) ELSE 0 END),2) AS target_sales FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id=i.order_id WHERE (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-05-01') OR (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-02-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-03-01')

SELECT p.product_category_name, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-02-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-03-01') THEN i.price ELSE -i.price END),2) AS delta_brl FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON i.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.product_id WHERE (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-05-01') OR (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-02-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-03-01') GROUP BY p.product_category_name HAVING ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-02-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-03-01') THEN i.price ELSE -i.price END),2) < 0 ORDER BY delta_brl, p.product_category_name NULLS LAST LIMIT 5

SELECT i.seller_id AS dimension_key, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-02-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-03-01') THEN i.price ELSE -i.price END),2) AS change_value FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON i.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.product_id WHERE ((o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-05-01') OR (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-02-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-03-01')) AND p.product_category_name = 'relogios_presentes' GROUP BY i.seller_id HAVING ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN (o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-02-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-03-01') THEN i.price ELSE -i.price END),2) < 0 ORDER BY change_value, i.seller_id NULLS LAST LIMIT 5

decisions.reason: The question asks whether sales changed due to order volume or average merchandise per order for 2018-02 versus 2018-04; monthly_drivers decomposes the change between order count and merchandise amount, which is the required first measurement.
Sales declined from 996,647.75 BRL in 2018-04 to 844,178.71 BRL in 2018-02, a negative change, so drilling down by category contributions is needed to identify which categories drove the decline.

Sales declined from 996,647.75 (2018-04) to 844,178.71 (2018-02 target), and the leading declining category is relogios_presentes. To drill down further, rank seller merchandise declines within this category.
